description: Land Acquisition - Miyanagolla, Ganga Ihala Korale, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire seven parcels of land for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of the land lots, their extents, names, and claimants. The content is published in "PART III – LANDS" and deals exclusively with land acquisition matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
